title: How to apply if you have a U.S. VISA

category.title: Applicants from Outside of the U.S. who have a U.S. VISA
content:
-Apply from Outside of the U.S
-Applicants who have stayed in the U.S. and have an F1 Visa
-Applicants who have studied in the U.S. within the past 5 months
※You need to get an F1 VISA again if it's been more than 5 months since you finished at a previous school.

category.title: Application Steps
content: If you have a valid U.S. visa , you don't have to get a new VISA. Bring your I-20 and vaild U.S. VISA and fly to the US.

Students are required to apply 1 or 2 months before desired starting date. It is best to speak with front desk staff after applying to confirm the application process as it can be complicated depending on your status.

category.title: Cancellation Policy
content: The enrollment fee of $150, will be charged at the time of application. The enrollment fee is non-refundable regardless if an application is rejected or enrollment is cancelled. Exceptions include insufficient housing.

category.title: About the steps after application
content:
After students have applied, the iMLI system processes the application.
Students can follow the process which is listed on the iMLI.

types.title: Apply Online
content:
Fill out the information about your visa status
Contact us via iMLI for all inquiries
*Please have your credit card in hand.
